newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet stumbles with NYMEX, diffs stable.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet stumbles with NYMEX, diffs stable.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel prices careened 2.50 cents lower by late Monday amid a steep NYMEX selloff prompted by rumors the U.S. had asked Saudi Arabia to step up oil production, players said.
The State Deptartment later denied any such request had been made, but not until after the close of the regular NYMEX session when futures had already taken their beating.

Differentials were narrowly mixed, with New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade fuel firming 0.15 cent to about 4.60 cents above October futures, players said. Gulf Coast material eased slightly to 1.35 cents over the print, players said.
